The key is to use a combination of two values: a near-zero value and a near-1000 value, arranged in a pattern that maximizes the distance between high values while still maintaining the sequence repr si. This is similar to spreading out signal components to reduce peak power in autocorrelation.

The search space is reduced by considering only two types of values, and the perturbation method is enhanced to capture changes only in the values near 1000.
